KR_ChestRead:
.LOCALREF part
	PUSH 1
	CALLHLL PartsEngine GetTextPartsText 0
	RETURN
KR_ChestWrite:
.LOCALREF part
	.LOCALREF text
	A_REF
	PUSH 1
	CALLHLL PartsEngine Parts_SetText 0
	POP
	RETURN
KR_ChestVisible:
.LOCALREF part
	.LOCALREF visible
	CALLHLL PartsEngine SetComponentShow 0
	RETURN
KR_ChestAlpha:
.LOCALREF part
	.LOCALREF alpha
	CALLHLL PartsEngine SetComponentAlpha 0
	RETURN
